message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/elfutils && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzz-libdwfl.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":24,"var":"data/size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim to a temporary file that becomes the fuzzed archive input."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzz-libdwfl.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":28,"var":"filename","code":"Dwfl_Module *mod = dwfl_report_offline(dwfl, filename, filename, -1);","note":"The temporary file path is handed to libdwfl as an offline module, so later parsing reads the attacker-controlled file."},
  {"step":3,"file":"libdwfl/dwfl_module_getdwarf.c","function":"dwfl_module_getdwarf","line":null,"var":"mod->main.elf","code":"dwfl_module_getdwarf(mod, &bias)","note":"Requesting DWARF for the module forces libdwfl to open the file through libelf and inspect its archive contents."},
  {"step":4,"file":"libelf/elf_begin.c","function":"dup_elf","line":1058,"var":"ref->state.ar.elf_ar_hdr.ar_name","code":"if (ref->state.ar.elf_ar_hdr.ar_name == NULL && __libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock (ref) != 0)","note":"When the input is recognized as an archive, libelf advances to the next member header before cloning the descriptor."},
  {"step":5,"file":"libelf/elf_begin.c","function":"__libelf_next_arhdr_wrlock","line":884,"var":"ar_hdr->ar_name","code":"else if (likely (isdigit (ar_hdr->ar_name[1]))) { ... if (unlikely (elf->state.ar.long_names == NULL && read_long_names (elf) == NULL)) ... }","note":"A long-name reference in the archive member name triggers loading of the archive string table."},
  {"step":6,"file":"libelf/elf_begin.c","function":"read_long_names","line":726,"var":"len","code":"len = atol (string); ... newp = malloc (len); ... memcpy (newp, elf->map_address + offset + sizeof (struct ar_hdr), len);","note":"The long-name table length is attacker-controlled; libelf allocates that many bytes and copies the table into the new buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"libelf/elf_begin.c","function":"read_long_names","line":780,"var":"runp","code":"runp = (char *) memchr (runp, '/', newp + len - runp); ... *runp++ = '\0';","note":"The parser walks and NUL-terminates slash-delimited names inside the copied table, using the attacker-controlled length and contents."},
  {"step":8,"file":"libelf/elf_begin.c","function":"dup_elf","line":1068,"var":"ref->state.ar.elf_ar_hdr.ar_size","code":"result = read_file (fildes, ref->state.ar.offset + sizeof (struct ar_hdr), ref->state.ar.elf_ar_hdr.ar_size, cmd, ref);","note":"The selected archive member size is then used to create a child descriptor for the member payload."},
  {"step":9,"file":"libdwfl/dwfl_module_getdwarf.c","function":"dwfl_module_getdwarf","line":null,"var":"child descriptor","code":"dwfl_module_getdwarf(mod, &bias)","note":"DWARF loading continues on the cloned archive member descriptor, reaching the vulnerable libelf archive-name handling path during parsing."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz-libdwfl.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
